description: The Rural Utilities collection describes pipelines below 700 kPa from annual as-built submissions, with pipe material, operating status, year built where known and distributor contact. A companion source describes franchise areas, community distributors and customer meters. The groups include co-operatives, municipalities, private systems, ATCO and Apex. An ArcGIS map-service descriptor accompanies pipeline metadata; franchise data currently list descriptive metadata links only. This curator grouping preserves linear assets and service-area components. Source warnings require contacting distributors for actual pipeline locations and disclaim completeness. No geometric network connectivity or current operational completeness was verified. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The source names Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above. Unlisted fields and numerical values remain unknown.
